name: Stormbringer: Waterfall critical damage reduces all Stormbringer cooldowns (#12930)
contract: #12930: Waterfall 806412 reads 'Dealing critical damage now reduces all of your cooldowns by 0.5 sec.', with
no internal cooldown. Its trigger Waterfall [CDR1] 807661 has three SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_COOLDOWN
effects naming Overload Mechanical 707365, Gust of Wind 500932 and Torrential Wrath 503352, so every other
cooldown was untouched. The PR author ruled that 'all of your cooldowns' means every Stormbringer spell on
cooldown and that any critical damage counts. spell_ascension_stormbringer_waterfall now takes 807661's -500
ms off every spell of its family on the player's cooldown map, and 806412's spell_proc row accepts every
damage class and periodic damage, still on critical hits only. Setup and timing follow
stormbringer-fix-random-chance-procs-waterfall: a control Stormbringer without Waterfall starts the same
Gust of Wind and Stormcloak 804833 cooldowns at the same moment, so elapsed time cancels out. Stormcloak (30
s, self-cast, off the global cooldown) is not one of the three named spells. Its cooldown only starts when
its 15 s buff ends (the first run read a placeholder cooldown until then and the reductions were lost), so
both casters cancel the buff straight after casting it, and its cooldown then runs normally, so its 4-5 *
500 ms reduction after four or five critical Shocks proves 'all'. Five Shocks with at least four Waterfall
procs, as in the #3638 scenario, because the taken-side crit roll is not a hard 100%. With at least four
procs asserted, both final cooldown checks accept -1900 to -2600 ms: four or five 500 ms reductions with 100
